name: Gold Of Minos

features.name: Minotaur expanded wild
features.description: Covers its whole reel when it lands.

features.name: Multiplier respins
features.description: Each empty respin raises the multiplier, up to 1,024x.

features.name: Three bonus buys
features.description: Different ways to start the respins where permitted.

review:
A 243-ways game where the Minotaur is an expanding wild that covers his whole reel. If he doesn't make a win, he starts a respin bonus instead – so a dud wild still sets something up.

The respins keep going until a win lands, and every empty respin raises the multiplier, up to 1,024x. A long run of misses builds towards one big multiplied hit. Medium-high volatility with a 15,360x max and 96% RTP. Same respin idea as Golden Pride, with a Greek-myth theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
